question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Being careful that every detail of something is correct
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fastidious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fastidious **means being very careful and attentive to details. (विवरणों के प्रति बहुत सावधान और चौकस रहना)

 
 
• **For example**: *She was known for her fastidious attention to detail in her artwork.*
 
 
 
• It is often used to describe someone who is very particular about cleanliness or orderliness.
 
• The word can also be used to describe a person who is hard to please or who has high standards.
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word "fastidiosus," which means "disgusted" or "disdainful."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squeamish **means easily nauseated or disgusted and is not a suitable substitute for the given group of words. (आसानी से मतली या घृणा होना)
 
• **Stubborn **means refusing to change one's opinion or course of action, and is not a suitable substitute for the given group of words. (किसी की राय या कार्रवाई के तरीके को बदलने से इनकार करना)
 
• **Impregnable **means unable to be captured or broken into and is not a suitable substitute for the given group of words. (पकड़ने या तोड़ने में असमर्थ)
